mechanism_decision.supported: Legal deterministic composition and source-certified localization are executable with unchanged candidate component bytes and no new updatercost.

mechanism_decision.strongest_competing_explanation: Ordinary execution variation plus residual artifact construction and output allocation could explain the observed gains and failures. Current evidence does not isolate pure length, salience, operator selection, or causal attribution.
mechanism_decision.next_rule: Do not recombine more closed components, reword prompts, or rerun this policy simply to obtain a passing draw. A further model trial needs a distinct source-supported decision in affected knowledge representation/validation with task-free inputs and a discriminating falsifiable test. Positive episodes are not a universal prerequisite; no new legal option is declared impossible or blocked merely because this version failed.
